title: lactuca dentata var. alpicola
intro: Lactuca dentata var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Prickly Lettuce, is a perennial plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Prickly Lettuce are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-bacterial and anti-viral activities, making it a promising treatment for various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca dentata var. alpicola include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
